adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff at app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6 lines 42-48, the delete action calls `this.get('host').destroyRecord().then(...)` but there is no `.catch()` handler. In contrast, the save action at lines 35-39 properly handles errors with `.catch(popupAjaxError)`. If the delete operation fails (network error, server error, etc.), the promise rejection will be unhandled, leaving the user without feedback about the failure. This is a real defect in error handling.
